extracted.intended_audience: Principal Investigators and institutional administrative staff preparing NIH PHS 398 / PA-16-200 (R15) grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and assembling all required components (biosketches, budget and budget justification, cover page supplement, and research plan) for an NIH PHS 398 R15 resubmission (A1) under PA-16-200, following form-specific instructions and attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch — format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include name, eRA Commons user name (credential), position title. Follow the provided format for each senior/key person and contributor; keep each biosketch ≤ 5 pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training entry requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List institution and location, degree (if applicable), completion date (MM/YYYY), and field of study for each stage of training beginning with baccalaureate. Modify rows as needed to reflect training history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosketch — Personal Statement (Section A)
rubrics_metrics.description: A. Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a concise personal statement summarizing the applicant's qualifications, expertise relevant to the project, and role in the proposed research. This section appears as part of the biosketch and should support the individual's ability to carry out the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosketch — Positions and Honors (Section B)
rubrics_metrics.description: B. Positions and Honors
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List positions/employment and relevant honors. Include dates, titles, institutional affiliations, professional memberships, editorial/review roles, and other relevant service as shown in the example.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosketch — Contribution to Science (Section C)
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Contribution to Science
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe up to several major contributions to science with narrative context and key representative publications; include how the work relates to the proposed project where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosketch — Research Support (Section D)
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Research Support
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List ongoing and completed research support. Identify role (PI, co-PI), project titles, funding source, dates, and brief description of relevance. Distinguish ongoing from completed support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Senior/Key Person Profile attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: RESEARCH & RELATED Senior/Key Person Profile (Expanded) ... Attach Biographical Sketch*: [file] Attach Current & Pending Support:
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach the individual's biosketch and current & pending support documents to the Senior/Key Person Profile. Provide required contact and credential fields (e.g., eRA Commons user name).

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Section A — Senior/Key Person fields
rubrics_metrics.description: A. Senior/Key Person: Prefix, First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Suffix, Project Role, Base Salary ($), Calendar Months, Academic Months, Summer Months, Requested Salary ($), Fringe Benefits ($), Funds Requested ($)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each senior/key person provide complete payroll and effort data (months and salaries), fringe, and total funds requested. Include totals for all senior/key persons in the attached budget file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Section B — Other Personnel fields
rubrics_metrics.description: B. Other Personnel: Number of Personnel, Project Role, Calendar Months, Academic Months, Summer Months, Requested Salary ($), Fringe Benefits, Funds Requested ($)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerate and justify requested support for postdocs, graduate students, undergraduates, technicians, clerical staff, etc., including effort (months), salary basis, fringe, and totals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Section C — Equipment threshold and listing
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Equipment Description List items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List each equipment item > $5,000 with requested amount; include a cumulative equipment total and attach supporting equipment list/file if needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Section D — Travel categories
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Travel: 1. Domestic Travel Costs (Incl. Canada, Mexico, and U.S. Possessions) 2. Foreign Travel Costs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide estimated domestic and foreign travel costs, with justification in the budget justification (e.g., conferences, collaborator visits), including breakdowns when appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Section E — Participant/Trainee Support costs
rubrics_metrics.description: E. Participant/Trainee Support Costs: 1. Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance 2. Stipends 3. Travel 4. Subsistence 5. Other; Number of Participants/Trainees
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If participant or trainee support is requested, itemize categories (tuition, stipends, travel, subsistence, other), specify number of trainees, and provide totals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Section F — Other Direct Costs categories
rubrics_metrics.description: F. Other Direct Costs: 1. Materials and Supplies 2. Publication Costs 3. Consultant Services 4. ADP/Computer Services 5. Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs 6. Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees 7. Alterations and Renovations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide line-item estimates for each other direct cost category; include explanations and citations for major items in the budget justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Section H — Indirect Costs (F&A) and cognizant agency
rubrics_metrics.description: H. Indirect Costs: Indirect Cost Type, Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($), Funds Requested ($). Cognizant Federal Agency (Agency Name, POC Name, and POC Phone Number)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify the negotiated F&A rate, base used to calculate indirect costs, total requested indirect costs, and provide the cognizant federal agency contact for the institution's rate agreement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget totals and fee
rubrics_metrics.description: I. Total Direct and Indirect Costs; J. Fee
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide cumulative totals for direct costs, indirect costs, total project costs, and any allowable fee. Ensure consistency between detailed sections and summary totals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — single-file attachment requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: K. Budget Justification* File Name: [file] (Only attach one file.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide one budget justification file that explains and justifies personnel, fringe, travel, materials and supplies, equipment, subawards, and other direct costs; explain basis for cost estimates and any special requests (e.g., course release, summer salary).

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — personnel effort and roles
rubrics_metrics.description: Personnel: Principal Investigator (academic months; summer months) ... Technician (hours/week; calendar months) ... Graduate Student ... Undergraduate Students ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe PI effort in academic and summer months and justify course-release/summer salary requests; define technician duties/hours and responsibilities; specify student support amounts and tasks; explain how personnel contribute to training objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — fringe benefits and calculation basis
rubrics_metrics.description: Fringe Benefits: Fringe benefits are calculated by the City University of New York (CUNY) and the Research Foundation of CUNY, and are as follows: • Release Time: 49% • Summer Salary: 26% • Part-time B (working 19 hours/week or less) Project Staff: 9.84% (A 0.34% MTA tax is included ...)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the fringe benefit rates used and the basis for their application to personnel categories; include institutional calculation details where required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — travel and justification detail
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Travel: Provide travel funds and itemized estimates (plane, lodging, per diem, registration, abstract fees, local travel, other) for conferences and collaborator visits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide destination, purpose (e.g., present poster, training), itemized cost breakdowns, number of travelers, and justification linking travel to project aims and trainee development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — materials, supplies and instrumentation fees
rubrics_metrics.description: F. Other Direct Costs — Materials and Supplies: PI requests $24,000 per year in supplies, reagents, and small equipment below $5,000. List of reagents, kits, consumables, facility fees, and instrumentation fees provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide detailed line-item supply estimates, cite vendor/catalog numbers or fee schedules where possible, and explain how items support specific aims and projected experiments.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Human Subjects questions
rubrics_metrics.description: 1. Human Subjects Section Clinical Trial? Yes/No *Agency-Defined Phase III Clinical Trial? Yes/No
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate whether the project involves human subjects, whether it is a clinical trial, and whether it is an agency-defined Phase III trial; provide required follow-up sections (Protection of Human Subjects, Data Safety Monitoring) in the Research Plan if Yes.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Vertebrate Animals questions
rubrics_metrics.description: 2. Vertebrate Animals Section Are vertebrate animals euthanized? Yes/No If 'Yes' to euthanasia Is the method consistent with American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) guidelines? Yes/No If 'No' to AVMA guidelines, describe method and provide scientific justification
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer whether vertebrate animals are used/euthanized; if euthanasia is used, confirm AVMA-consistent methods or provide justification and description if not consistent.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Program Income
rubrics_metrics.description: 3. Program Income Section Is program income anticipated during the periods for which the grant support is requested? Yes/No If you checked 'yes' above... use the format below to reflect the amount and source(s): Budget Period, Anticipated Amount ($), Source(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Declare anticipated program income and provide per-budget-period amount and source details when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Human Embryonic Stem Cells
rubrics_metrics.description: 4. Human Embryonic Stem Cells Section Does the proposed project involve human embryonic stem cells? Yes/No If yes, list registration number(s) from the NIH registry or check box that one from the registry will be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State whether hESCs are involved and if so, provide official registry numbers or commit to using a registry-listed line and identify it later.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Inventions and Patents (Renewal)
rubrics_metrics.description: 5. Inventions and Patents Section (RENEWAL) Inventions and Patents: Yes/No If the answer is 'Yes' then please answer the following: Previously Reported: Yes/No
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose invention/patent status for renewal applications and indicate whether inventions have been previously reported.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Change of Investigator / Institution
rubrics_metrics.description: 6. Change of Investigator / Change of Institution Section Change of Project Director / Principal Investigator Name of former Project Director / Principal Investigator ... Change of Grantee Institution Name of former institution:
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For change requests provide identifying details of former PD/PI or former institution as required by the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Plan — required components (PHS 398 Research Plan)
rubrics_metrics.description: PHS 398 Research Plan required sections: 1. Introduction (Resubmission and Revision) 2. Specific Aims 3. Research Strategy 4. Progress Report Publication List 5. Protection of Human Subjects 6. Data Safety Monitoring Plan 7. Inclusion of Women and Minorities 8. Inclusion of Children 9. Vertebrate Animals 10. Select Agent Research 11. Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan 12. Consortium/Contractual Arrangements 13. Letters of Support 14. Resource Sharing Plan(s) 15. Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources 16. Appendix
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include each listed Research Plan component as applicable; attach relevant files (Specific Aims, Research Strategy, Letters of Support, Authentication of Key Resources, etc.) and ensure required human/animal/ethics sections are completed when relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resubmission (A1) Introduction — address prior critique
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction to Application (Resubmission and Revision) — This is a resubmission (A1) of application..., changes are not marked in the text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For A1 resubmissions include an Introduction that explains how previous reviewers' critiques were addressed and describes substantive revisions; note whether changes are marked or not per instructions.
